messages:
Noelle (Support): Escalation: priority Dedicated provision for NovaRetail stuck in pending state >24h. Customer in procurement hold; they expect Dedicated before pilot conversion. Renewal conversation in 9 days. @Omar can you own? :rotating_light:
Omar (CS): On it. Need exact blocker, ETA from infra, and a comms plan. @Hector heads up for contract implications.
Leah (Solutions): I saw a failure in provisioning API: paste below. Noelle, include tenant id and order id.
Noelle (Support): Error snippet:
```
2026-12-08T07:14:01Z provision_api error=RESOURCE_ASSIGNMENT_FAILED code=430 tenant=nova-retail-77 order=ORD-9987 region=eu-west-1
```
Order placed 2026-12-06 13:02 UTC. Ticket 94722.
Hector (Sales): Customer expects Dedicated for data isolation during SOC review. If we miss the commit window they may walk. I'll escalate with ACV owners. Need comms: immediate acknowledgement, ETA, and options if delay persists.
Omar (CS): Comms plan draft: 1) Immediate ack + transparency about cause 2) Offer hosted private routing (short-term) + encrypted-at-rest assurances 3) Provide weekly checkpoints and exec sponsor touch 4) If delay >72h, offer a credit or temporary Dedicated on partner infra. Owner=Omar, tech=Leah, sales=Hector. Renewal_flag=true.
Leah (Solutions): Root cause appears to be resource assignment in eu-west-1 due to GPU pool fragmentation after recent capacity commitments. Options: A) schedule infra capacity shift (24-48h) B) provision in eu-central-1 as fallback (requires customer approval for region) C) temporary dedicated-like tenancy on hosted cluster with IP allowlist (short-term). Which do we prefer?
security-bot: Provisioning runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/dedicated-provision-fail (link)
Noelle (Support): Customer prefers eu-west-1 for latency. They asked if we can guarantee isolation and compliance while we wait.
Hector (Sales): I'll ping customer execs offering region fallback if needed but will also request a 24h grace window. I'll attach a formal note offering a one-time onboarding credit if timing slips.
Omar (CS): Leah, please open an infra escalation and request a targeted capacity carve for nova-retail-77. Also prepare the hosted-temporary configuration doc showing encryption, logs retention policy, and isolation controls to reassure security team.
Leah (Solutions): Infra paged, escalation INC-9901 created. I've prepared the hosted-temporary config snippet to share. Excerpt:
```
hosted_temp_config:
  isolation: namespace-segmentation
  encryption: AES-256 at-rest + TLS1.3 in transit
  access: IP allowlist + customer-managed API keys
  retention: 30d audit logs
```
Can share with customer in comms.
Noelle (Support): Customer replied: will accept hosted-temp if we provide a compliance checklist and a signed attestation. They requested ETA update within 6h.
Omar (CS): I'll send immediate ack: explain root cause, propose hosted-temp + region fallback options, commit to 6h ETA for infra response, and schedule a 30m call to walk compliance checklist. Hector please prep contract note re: one-time credit.
Hector (Sales): Drafted contract note for credit. Also looping in legal for attestation language. Sending to customer now.
Leah (Solutions): Infra responded: can carve capacity in eu-west in ~36h if we reallocate scheduled jobs; immediate carve not possible. We can provision hosted-temp in 2-3h and eu-central fallback in ~6h.
Omar (CS): Update customer with options and recommended path: accept hosted-temp now while we secure eu-west carve (we'll prioritize). Attach the config and offer assisted onboarding. Also assign exec sponsor for relationship continuity.
Noelle (Support): Sent the update to customer at 10:12 UTC. Customer accepted hosted-temp and requested attestation before onboarding.
security-bot: Attestation template: https://contracts.redwood/dedicated-attestation-template (link)
Omar (CS): Great. Leah, coordinate with infra to deploy hosted-temp and provide attestation signed by Security lead. Hector, confirm credit offer language. I'll run the onboarding call and ensure the customer signs acceptance.
Leah (Solutions): Deploying hosted-temp for nova-retail-77 now. ETA ~2h. Will post deployment ID and verification steps when done.
Noelle (Support): Noted. Ticket 94722 updated, renewal_flag remains until eu-west capacity confirmed.
Hector (Sales): Customer accepted credit language and exec sponsor intro. Sending summary to customer and legal.
Leah (Solutions): Hosted-temp deployed at 12:25 UTC. Verification steps: confirm IP allowlist + API key exchange. Pushed audit logs to shared bucket.
Noelle (Support): Customer completed verification and onboarded to hosted-temp. They thanked the team and noted they'll proceed with SOC review on hosted-temp.
Omar (CS): Closing loop: immediate risk mitigated, renewal de-escalated for now. Remaining actions: Leah to track eu-west carve status (ETA 36h), Omar to send post-provision summary and schedule 1-week check-in, Hector to confirm one-time credit applied. Postmortem owner=Leah. ETA for postmortem 5 business days. Thanks team. :handshake:
